app.name: Trade Robot

Paper-first trading workstation for Futu OpenD.
If unsure, it does nothing.

settings.secrets_help: Secrets are stored in the OS keychain/credential vault and are never written to disk or logs. Secrets are namespaced per active profile.

settings.live_step_4: 4. Ensure a global kill switch hotkey is set.

This application can place real orders when live trading is unlocked. You can lose substantial amounts of money. You are responsible for verifying symbols, quantities, and risk limits.

If anything looks wrong, use the Kill Switch immediately.

ma_crossover.name: MA Crossover
ma_crossover.description: Long-only: buys when fast SMA crosses above slow SMA; sells when it crosses below.

mean_reversion.name: Mean Reversion
mean_reversion.description: Long-only: buys when price is far below mean (z <= -entry); exits when it mean-reverts (z >= -exit).

rhai_script.name: Custom Script (Rhai)
rhai_script.description: Sandboxed custom strategy script (disabled in live mode).

short_term_momentum_bot.name: Short-Term Momentum Bot
short_term_momentum_bot.description: Short-horizon momentum entries with stop/take/horizon exits and optional AI confirmation gate.

zscore.name: Z-Score
zscore.description: Z-score of close relative to SMA(period) and stddev(period).

guide.title: Operations Guide
guide.subtitle: This page is the runbook for traders, strategy developers, and operators. Follow these steps as executable procedures, not marketing tips.

steps.1: Set profile to paper and verify engine status is running.
steps.2: Configure non-default risk limits before any strategy run.
steps.3: Configure and test a global kill switch hotkey.
steps.4: Set OpenD host/port and run a connectivity test.
steps.5: Add 3-5 symbols to watchlist and verify quote updates.
steps.6: Place one small manual paper order and verify fill trail in Audit.
steps.7: Start one built-in strategy with conservative params.
steps.8: Review signals, orders, and risk events in Audit/Diagnostics.

items.1: If uncertain, do nothing. Safety beats activity.
items.2: All model outputs are advisory; risk engine is authoritative.
items.3: No live unlock without explicit checklist completion.
items.4: Treat connectivity degradation as a halt condition.
items.5: Every critical action must be auditable with trace ID.

items.1: Draft: parameter shaping and failure-mode checks.
items.2: Paper: multi-session validation with stable behavior.
items.3: Research: replay/backtest against fixed datasets and seeds.
items.4: Live: unlock only after Go/No-Go checklist passes.

items.1: Risk disclaimer read and confirmation phrase entered exactly.
items.2: Risk limits are non-default and saved.
items.3: Kill switch hotkey configured and tested.
items.4: OpenD trade environment set to real.
items.6: OpenD connectivity and account checks pass.
items.7: At least one full paper rehearsal completed today.
items.8: Operator confirms incident response path is ready.

pre.1: Confirm engine is not in safe mode and kill switch is off.
pre.2: Verify quote stream health and event latency.
pre.3: Re-check risk limits, sessions, and cooldown windows.
pre.4: Lock strategy/model versions for the session.
pre.5: Run a small paper dry-run if any config changed.

during.1: Monitor reject rate, fill latency, and risk utilization.
during.2: Reduce concurrency during abnormal volatility spikes.
during.3: If order behavior is abnormal, trigger kill switch first.
during.4: Resume only after root cause and replay verification.

after.1: Export audit JSONL and archive with date/profile tags.
after.2: Summarize PnL, incidents, rejected orders, and mitigations.
after.3: Record every parameter change with rationale.
after.4: Queue next-day changes in paper mode only.

items.1: Trigger kill switch from top bar or global hotkey.
items.2: Capture evidence: Audit events, logs, and snapshot.
items.3: Freeze config changes until cause is identified.
items.4: Reproduce in paper/replay and verify mitigation.
items.5: Resume with reduced risk limits and heightened monitoring.

flow.1: Safety model and compliance boundaries (20 min).
flow.2: Paper workflow drill: market, order, strategy, audit (25 min).
flow.3: Backtest and model evaluation drill (20 min).
flow.4: Live unlock simulation without real order submission (15 min).
flow.5: Incident drill: kill switch + audit export in under 30 seconds (10 min).

scoring.1: Can independently complete full paper workflow.
scoring.2: Can explain each core risk control and trigger.
scoring.3: Can execute kill switch and evidence export under pressure.
